svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The venue screen in the app's own look: open, teams drawn, the bracket live, champion (attendees in the hall)
svg.text: 12 · The venue screen in the app's own look: open, teams drawn, the bracket live, champion
Use case: the hall follows the finals without a phone; the cards use the app's graphics, the platform frame places and times them; the bracket is a Pulse widget while the season runs

g.text: FINALS ARE OPEN · TEAMS OF THREE

svg.text: A takeover when the season opens and again before it closes: the count fills, the QR joins.
At the start: every team and its three players, then the bracket. Names follow the screen's names setting.
While the season runs, the bracket is the hero widget from the live round on (played rounds fold away);
the next match shows in the frame's top bar.

g.text: 2 – 1 AGAINST TEAM ALPHA IN THE FINAL

svg.text: The deciding game of the final ends the season: the champions' takeover with the three players.

From the app: its palette (the dark red ladder, white team bars with the black score cell, gold for advancing and the champion, pink round labels), its italic uppercase type and its trophy. The app ships no image files; its look is
CSS, so the card is drawn from those values (L12).

From the platform frame: the screen's grid and 40 px safe area, the timing, the top bar (event, what's next, clock) and the widget slot the bracket fills. Lobby codes never appear on a screen (U8). The card windows (15 and 10 minutes)
